Recessed deep navy blue felt back panels, subtle warm overhead lighting under the lintel of each row. The open spaces are entirely empty and unobstructed, consistent lighting and heights, ample headroom for separately composited trophy icons. Thin frame and shelf lips so the trophy display space dominates. Transparent outside the cabinet silhouette; navy felt remains opaque inside. No trophies, books, props, text, logo, lettering, digits, watermark, scenery or floor.
